items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. Case 25 supports €53 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured fitting. Case 25 supports €27 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary fitting-repair labour. Three hours at €95 gross per hour gives €285, consistent with Case 25.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used on the fitting repair, but §3.6(c) excludes the contractor's own small equipment. Case 25 supports a small allowance of €7 if the materials qualify.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the covered fitting repair. Case 25 supports €41 gross.

items.description: Thermal camera use for leak location
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the escape. A €25 gross use charge fits Case 25's upper bound and is well within the €2,500 gross event cap.
Section 7.1.11 excludes a second attendance by the same undertaking unless agreed in advance, and no approval is reported. If approved, the comparable single-trip allowance is €41 gross.

items.description: Remove loose and spalled facade plaster
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement and §§2.6.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of failed render from the damaged area. Allow €110 gross for each of the two billed removal units, excluding disposal.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the frost-damaged area. Allow €115 gross for the material line, with labour billed separately.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover necessary substrate reinstatement on the damaged area. Allow €180 gross for distinct making-good work not already billed as base plaster or painter hours.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover necessary priming of the affected area. Allow €55 gross for this step, with painter hours separately billed.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying needed before reinstatement, but not a separate charge for ordinary passive curing. Allow €90 gross if a distinct drying measure was necessary.

items.description: Facade paint system, four coats billed
items.rationale: Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover only the coats required by the equivalent pre-loss finish on the affected area. Allow €200 gross for the paint line, excluding separately billed labour and any unsupported extra coats.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover painter labour on the frost-damaged area only; the rear repaint is billed separately. Five hours at €70 gross per hour gives €350.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover necessary scaffold access, without a rear-work allocation because the scaffold was struck before that work began. Allow €850 gross for short-term access to the roughly 48 m² two-storey frontage, including setup and removal.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate undamaged elevation, even for colour matching. The €600 gross figure is a conditional price estimate only.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.1 cover transport and disposal of debris from the insured repair. A few rubble sacks warrant €65 gross, not a skip charge.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude an administrative surcharge that prices no repair work. The €25 gross figure is a conditional price estimate only.
Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.12 exclude subsistence for the contractor's own crew. The €18 gross figure is a conditional price estimate for three portions only.
